statement: HHD has an optional synchronous-gyro policy that sends refreshed reports on IMU timestamp events and a fallback generating timestamps if IMU updates stop; this is an emulator-specific compatibility strategy for Steam gyro-to-mouse.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: HHD dualsense/__init__.py 363-368, 436-443, 516-548. Do not infer that the physical DualSense implements an identical event-driven report scheduler. Part 2 I role correction: this HHD virtual-emulator policy is consumer/compatibility implementation evidence; it is not retail DualSense device shape. No claim status or sources changed.
